ORDINANCE Septem ber 2S, 2625—

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-
Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map
Number 11-H in the area bounded by:

A line 125.00 feet north of and parallel to West Montrose Avenue; a line
62.00 feet east of and parallel to North Hamilton Avenue; West Montrose
Avenue; and North Hamilton Avenue

to those of an B2-1.5 Neighborhood Mixed Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its

passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4401-4411 N. Hamilton Ave.
2114-2118 W. Montrose Ave.
